verdict.rationale: Stripe Invoicing ships fixed, configurable event-driven automations: automatic reminders and payment retries when an invoice is overdue or payment fails, configurable email notifications, and automatic charging of the payment method on file. It also emits webhooks on invoice state transitions, so users can build their own triggered actions in code. However, the evidence shows no general user-defined rule engine for arbitrary event→action logic; custom rules require building against webhooks/API. missing for 10: native user-definable rule/workflow builder, arbitrary event-condition-action configuration, independent corroboration.
